19.name: Singapore Grand Prix
19.resultsNote: Verstappen led all 62 laps from pole. No point was available for the fastest lap. Gap column carries the interval exactly as published; unclassified drivers carry a null position.

20.name: United States Grand Prix
20.resultsNote: Antonelli won from pole for his ninth win of 2026. Leclerc took the fastest lap (1:37.976, lap 42); no point was available for it. Valtteri Bottas retired with an engine failure but was classified (48 laps, over 90% distance). Franco Colapinto and Oliver Bearman retired with collision damage.
